description: One seat file. It is the single tracked map from a worktree (its basename, as sessions[].checkout records it) to seat, role, agent name and hub name (T-203, closing G-049): ob_start resolves the reader by CHECKOUT, never by AGENT.local.md, and /sync flags an AGENT.local.md that disagrees. ob_start also reads readers for partner presence (T-198), and the hub-seats check reads talk, seats and readers (T-196). worktree-seats.json stays the layout rule (which <project>-<seat> names may exist) and holds no seat attribute. Room ids were read from hub-talk --as atlas --list --json on 2026-09-28. hub_name is a plain field, never derived from the seat name (D-115); the forge seat still speaks as grok until T-213 repoints it.
talk_tokens: Substitute {hub_url}, {hub_name}, and {room} only. Replace <A2A-Hub> with the absolute path of the local checkout of https://github.com/melvenac/A2A-Hub that contains scripts/hub-talk.mjs. The angle-bracket token is not filled from this file.
